name: Cape Charles
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Cape Charles?
answer_short: Only on designated streets posted 25 mph or less, with a town decal. Cape Charles follows that Virginia cap. The street list is not on this map yet, so plain golf carts stay red except a tagged cart path. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less.

golf_cart.roads: Designated streets posted 25 mph or less

rules.rule: Golf carts only on streets the town designates, posted 25 mph or less, sunrise to sunset unless equipped
A golf cart on a public road in town needs a current town decal
The town states that golf carts operate in 25 mph zones
LSVs on highways posted 35 mph or less

banned_roads.name: Old Cape Charles Road where it is posted 35 mph
banned_roads.rule: Over the 25 mph golf cart cap

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Cape Charles?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Do I need a decal in Cape Charles?
faq.a: Yes. The town requires a golf cart decal on carts driven on public roads.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on a 35 mph road?
faq.a: No. The town and Virginia law keep golf carts to streets posted 25 mph or less.
